summary: Ekso Bionics Holdings filed an 8-K/A reporting its acquisition by Applied Digital Corporation via a business combination. Under the Contribution and Exchange Agreement dated February 15, 2026, Applied Digital contributed its subsidiary Applied Digital Cloud Corporation through APLD Intermediate HoldCo and APLD ChronoScale HoldCo. At closing on May 5, 2026, Ekso changed its name to ChronoScale Corporation and Cloud became its wholly owned subsidiary. The filing amends the original 8-K to disclose material terms of the business combination and a related PIPE investment. No per-share price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for post-merger integration and regulatory compliance as ChronoScale trades under CHRN on Nasdaq.
